text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) 2026.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 13 Februari 2026 hingga 21 Februari 2026.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Kepak ayam

2. Ikan bawal putih (berat antara 200 gram hingga 400 gram seekor)

3. Udang putih (berat antara 41 ekor hingga 60 ekor sekilogram)

4. Sawi pendek/Sawi Jepun

5. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

6. Halia tua import

7. Lobak putih import

8. Lobak merah (China)

9. Babi hidup

10. Daging babi (perut)

11. Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

Dibuat 6 Februari 2026

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/JLD.14]

DATUK ARMIZAN BIN MOHD ALI

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Kos Sara Hidup

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) ORDER 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

Order 2026.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for the

period from 13 February 2026 to 21 February 2026.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Chicken wing

2. White pomfret (weight ranges between 200 grams to 400 grams each)

3. Banana prawn (weight ranges between 41 prawns to 60 prawns

per kilogram)

4. Pak choy

5. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including Beijing

cabbage)

6. Imported old ginger

7. Imported radish

8. Carrot (China)

9. Live pig

10. Pork (belly)

11. Pork (lean and fat)
